name: Gwenna
description: The elf whose actions let Urza and Mishra discover Argoth, who sacrifices her life to trap a shadow being.

description_citations.text: "The Colors of Magic". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Temken convinces Gwenna to help trap the malevolent shadow in the bayou; Gwenna dies, letting Temken lead the elves to safety.
timeline.quote: Together, Temken and Gwenna fight the shadow being and succeed in trapping it, although Gwenna sacrifices her life in the process.

citation.text: "The Colors of Magic", section "A Song out of Darkness , by Loren L. Coleman". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Harbin crashes on Argoth; Gwenna sends word, but the Citanul Elder arrives too late and Harbin escapes.
timeline.quote: the Citanul Elder did not reach the site of trespass in time before Harbin had escaped the island

citation.text: "Citanul", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Hajar accompanies Mishra to Argoth, but Ashnod displaces him as closest to Mishra and arranges for him and Gwenna to board a ship, so he misses the Battle at Argoth and the Sylex Blast.
timeline.quote: Ashnod arranged for Hajar and Gwenna to board a ship for the mainland

citation.text: "Hajar", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

pages_say.description: Fighter who stayed her hand once to save young Harbin.
